This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

You are the guesser.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Submit each turn's guesses by calling `submit_guesses`. You may submit fewer than N guesses.

2. **LITTER** – rabbits famously have litters of babies
3. **TOOTH** – rabbits are known for their prominent front teeth (and they never stop growing)

These three seem like the clearest rabbit connections.

You are the guesser.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

function.name: submit_guesses
function.description: Submit up to N guesses for this turn, most confident first.

messages.content:
You are the spymaster.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Give each clue by calling `submit_clue`.

Your team's words (9): BELL, BUCK, BOX, KID, COTTON, TRUNK, STATE, HAWK, FIGHTER
Neutral words (16): SEAL, DRAFT, BANK, ROSE, STRING, CONCERT, MINT, SOCK, LION, TORCH, PILOT, LAP, PORT, MOUSE, PHOENIX, FORCE

Turn 1 of 10. Give your clue.

Looking at my 9 words (BELL, BUCK, BOX, KID, COTTON, TRUNK, STATE, HAWK, FIGHTER), I can see a strong boxing cluster: BOX (boxing), FIGHTER (prizefighter), and BELL (the round bell). messages.content:
You are the spymaster.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Give each clue by calling `submit_clue`.

Your team's words (9): BELL, BUCK, BOX, KID, COTTON, TRUNK, STATE, HAWK, FIGHTER
Neutral words (16): SEAL, DRAFT, BANK, ROSE, STRING, CONCERT, MINT, SOCK, LION, TORCH, PILOT, LAP, PORT, MOUSE, PHOENIX, FORCE

Turn 1 of 10. Give your clue.

Looking at my team's words, I need to find strong associations.

Key observation: **BELL, BOX, FIGHTER** all connect to the boxing ring — a bell signals rounds, boxing happens in a ring, and a fighter/boxer works the ring. The clue "ring" capturesall three and isn't a form of any board word.

I'll start there.

function.description: Give your clue for this turn.

number.description: How many of your team's words the clue relates to.

messages.content:
You are the guesser.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Submit each turn's guesses by calling `submit_guesses`. You may submit fewer than N guesses.

Board (25 words): BUCK, BELL, BANK, CONCERT, DRAFT, ROSE, STRING, SOCK, TRUNK, LION, KID, PORT, PHOENIX, BOX, MINT, MOUSE, SEAL, LAP, COTTON, HAWK, STATE, FORCE, TORCH, FIGHTER, PILOT

Turn 1 of 10. Clue: ring, 3

- **BELL** — a bell rings
- **BOX** — a boxing ring
- **FIGHTER** — fights in a ring

messages.content:
You are the spymaster.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Give each clue by calling `submit_clue`.

Neutral words (16): BILL, SEAL, AMBULANCE, OCTOPUS, FIRE, PRINCESS, ENGLAND, DAY, TIME, POLICE, PRESS, OLYMPUS, LOCH NESS, SOLDIER, CODE, ENGINE

Turn 1 of 10. Give your clue.

Team words: EYE, SATURN, PORT, CHARGE, LAB, SCUBA DIVER, OLIVE, SKYSCRAPER, ROSE

I'll lead with this 4-word clue to grab a big chunk early.

You are the spymaster.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

messages.content:
You are the spymaster.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Give each clue by calling `submit_clue`.

Your team's words (9): HOOD, CODE, LITTER, SPIKE, BEAR, BOMB, POISON, BUG, KNIFE
Neutral words (16): ROULETTE, BELT, PIE, DRAGON, BAR, BRIDGE, MODEL, MATCH, BOARD, FAIR, BUCK, PRINCESS, MICROSCOPE, BERLIN, RAY, CENTER

Turn 1 of 10. Give your clue.

messages.content:
You are the spymaster.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Give each clue by calling `submit_clue`.

Your team's words (9): HOOD, CODE, LITTER, SPIKE, BEAR, BOMB, POISON, BUG, KNIFE
Neutral words (16): ROULETTE, BELT, PIE, DRAGON, BAR, BRIDGE, MODEL, MATCH, BOARD, FAIR, BUCK, PRINCESS, MICROSCOPE, BERLIN, RAY, CENTER

Turn 1 of 10. Give your clue.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Submit each turn's guesses by calling `submit_guesses`. You may submit fewer than N guesses.

messages.content:
You are the guesser.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Submit each turn's guesses by calling `submit_guesses`. You may submit fewer than N guesses.

You are the guesser.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

messages.content:
You are the spymaster.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Give each clue by calling `submit_clue`.

Your team's words (9): NOVEL, SHAKESPEARE, LASER, FOOT, CHINA, CZECH, STREAM, ALIEN, ICE CREAM
Neutral words (16): PHOENIX, SCUBA DIVER, BOTTLE, HOTEL, PUMPKIN, SHIP, TAP, BARK, TRACK, LEMON, COTTON, TELESCOPE, NEEDLE, TOWER, MEXICO, COMPOUND

Turn 1 of 10. Give your clue.

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

You are the spymaster.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

messages.content:
You are the guesser.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Submit each turn's guesses by calling `submit_guesses`. You may submit fewer than N guesses.

You are the guesser.

messages.content:
You are the spymaster.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Give each clue by calling `submit_clue`.

Your team's words (9): SHOT, FILE, UNDERTAKER, KEY, SWITCH, TURKEY, SPIKE, PLAY, AZTEC
Neutral words (16): NURSE, WITCH, FIELD, SPIDER, BED, COMPOUND, CARROT, LAP, OCTOPUS, FENCE, LEMON, PORT, CANADA, ROBOT, AMBULANCE, TRIANGLE

Turn 1 of 10. Give your clue.

messages.content:
You are the guesser.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Submit each turn's guesses by calling `submit_guesses`. You may submit fewer than N guesses.

Board (25 words): OLYMPUS, LAB, DAY, OCTOPUS, EYE, PORT, SCUBA DIVER, SATURN, BILL, ENGINE, FIRE, PRINCESS, CODE, SKYSCRAPER, SOLDIER, OLIVE, SEAL, ROSE, POLICE, LOCH NESS, CHARGE, TIME, AMBULANCE, ENGLAND, PRESS

Turn 1 of 10. Clue: BLACK, 4

messages.content:
You are the spymaster.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Give each clue by calling `submit_clue`.

Turn 1 of 10. Give your clue.

function.name: submit_guesses
function.description: Submit up to N guesses for this turn, most confident first.

messages.content:
You are the spymaster.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Give each clue by calling `submit_clue`.

Your team's words (9): HOOD, CODE, LITTER, SPIKE, BEAR, BOMB, POISON, BUG, KNIFE
Neutral words (16): ROULETTE, BELT, PIE, DRAGON, BAR, BRIDGE, MODEL, MATCH, BOARD, FAIR, BUCK, PRINCESS, MICROSCOPE, BERLIN, RAY, CENTER

Turn 1 of 10. Give your clue.

You are the guesser.

function.name: submit_guesses
function.description: Submit up to N guesses for this turn, most confident first.

messages.content:
You are the spymaster.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Give each clue by calling `submit_clue`.

Your team's words (9): BELL, BUCK, BOX, KID, COTTON, TRUNK, STATE, HAWK, FIGHTER
Neutral words (16): SEAL, DRAFT, BANK, ROSE, STRING, CONCERT, MINT, SOCK, LION, TORCH, PILOT, LAP, PORT, MOUSE, PHOENIX, FORCE

Turn 1 of 10. Give your clue.

messages.content:
You are the guesser.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Submit each turn's guesses by calling `submit_guesses`. You may submit fewer than N guesses.

function.name: submit_clue
function.description: Give your clue for this turn.

number.description: How many of your team's words the clue relates to.

messages.content:
You are the guesser.

This is a cooperative, single-team version of the word game Codenames. There are 25 words on the board: 9 belong to your team and 16 are neutral. The spymaster knows which words are the team's; the guesser does not.

Each turn the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number N. The guesser then submits up to N guesses, in order. Guesses are revealed in order: a team word is correct, and the first neutral word ends the turn (any later guesses are discarded).

Clue rules: a single English word (no spaces, hyphens, or digits) that is not one of the words on the board and not a form or part of one.

Goal: reveal all 9 team words in as few turns as possible. The game ends after 10 turns.

Submit each turn's guesses by calling `submit_guesses`. You may submit fewer than N guesses.

Board (25 words): BARK, CLOAK, MERCURY, TEMPLE, KEY, GERMANY, BUG, HEAD, ROULETTE, PIANO, PIN, OPERA, PLOT, SHOE, HAM, LUCK, FIGHTER, FIRE, LIGHT, DRILL, PAN, CHOCOLATE, SCREEN, WASHINGTON, WAR

Turn 1 of 10. Clue: GRILL, 3
